name: swap(std::jthread)
intro: Overloads the std::swap algorithm for std::jthread. Exchanges the state of lhs with that of rhs. Effectively calls lhs.swap(rhs). This function  is not visible to ordinary unqualified or qualified lookup, and can only be found by argument-dependent lookup when std::jthread is an associated class of the arguments.

sections.title: Parameters
sections.text:
lhs, rhs

 -

 jthreads whose states to swap
